shared_elements: horizontal band or register of pattern
incised/low-relief carving on a stone surface
repeated linear texture used as decoration
justification: The most specific correspondence is that both surfaces combine profile living figures with carved linear patterning and at least some horizontal organization. The biggest difference is that A is a rough, crowded, schematic composition in stacked bands, while B is a spacious, naturalistic relief dominated by a large profile human and two large animal heads.
